title: tc-step-picker
description: Search step kinds and tools to add next to a workflow – grouped, with suggested and recent steps first.

items.description: Every step that can be added

groups.description: The groups, in order; an item whose group isn't here is left out

suggestions.description: Steps to suggest when nothing is typed, each with why ("Usually comes after Classify")

recent.description: Ids of recently added steps, newest first – shown when nothing is typed

query.description: The search text. Changed by the user unless a tc-query-change listener calls preventDefault()

placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the search field

open.description: In popover layout: whether it's showing. Closed by the user (Escape, outside, a pick) unless prevented

kinds.description: Labels and icons for kinds the page adds, merged over the workflow defaults

kind.description: The kind of step it adds – sets the icon (trigger, llm, tool, condition, approval, output, or your own)

description.description: One line on what it does

group.description: The group's id it's listed under

tool.description: The tool or integration it uses, e.g. "Ledger API" – shown as a tag and sent with the pick

keywords.description: More words that should find it

TemplateResult.description:
The return type of the template tag functions,  {@linkcode  html }  and  {@linkcode  svg } .

A `TemplateResult` object holds all the information about a template expression required to render it: the template strings, expression values, and type of template (html or svg).

`TemplateResult` objects do not create any DOM on their own. To create or update DOM you need to render the `TemplateResult`. See [Rendering](https://lit.dev/docs/components/rendering) for more information.

In Lit 4, this type will be an alias of MaybeCompiledTemplateResult, so that code will get type errors if it assumes that Lit templates are not compiled. When deliberately working with only one, use either  {@linkcode  CompiledTemplateResult }  or  {@linkcode  UncompiledTemplateResult }  explicitly.
